Class Board

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.am56.model.board.Board
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class Board extends Object implements Serializable
Shared central board holding the structures every player interacts with during a round:
  • the pool of OrderTiles used by players to pick their turn order,
  • the seven OfferTiles where totems are placed,
  • two rows (upper / lower) of BuildingCards,
  • two rows (upper / lower) of character / event Cards.
The class implements Serializable so the full board can be snapshotted by the persistence layer.

    • fillUpperBuildings

      public void fillUpperBuildings(int gameSize, BuildingDeck buildingsDeck, int era)
      Draws the era- and player-count–dependent number of building cards into the upper row. The counts are:
      • era 1 — 1 card (2 players) or 2 cards (3+),
      • era 2 — 2 cards (≤3 players) or 3 cards (4+),
      • era 3 — 3 cards (2 players), 4 cards (3 / 4) or 5 cards (5).
      Parameters:
      gameSize - number of players in the game
      buildingsDeck - deck to draw building cards from
      era - current era (1, 2 or 3)

    • removeCard

      public void removeCard(Card c)
      Removes the given card from whichever of the four card rows currently holds it. The call is a no-op if the card is not on the board.
      Parameters:
      c - the card to remove
